article.headline: Sayler scores 23 as South Dakota State takes down North Dakota 91-83
article.description: — Joe Sayler scored 23 points as South Dakota State beat North Dakota 91-83 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Sayler scores 23 as South Dakota State takes down North Dakota 91-83

categories.description: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits

event.description: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits

keywords: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits
article.story: BROOKINGS, S.D. -- — Joe Sayler scored 23 points as South Dakota State beat North Dakota 91-83 on Saturday. Sayler also added eight rebounds for the Jackrabbits (13-16, 6-8 Summit League). Matthew Mors added 18 points while going 7 of 10 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) while they also had seven rebounds. Damon Wilkinson finished with 15 points. Greyson Uelmen led the Fightin' Hawks (16-15, 10-5) in scoring, finishing with 19 points. Garrett Anderson added 18 points and seven rebounds for North Dakota. Eli King finished with 14 points and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
